labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory about Pygments, not a Rich defect.

body:
This report concerns the Pygments dependency, not Rich itself, so it is labelled `upstream`. Rich declares `pygments = "^2.13.0"` in [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/pyproject.toml). Any change to that minimum version is a maintainer decision, so no version bump is promised here. To report a vulnerability in Rich privately, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md) instead of a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
